SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM (
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.from AS account, 'debit' AS side, t.value AS amount, 'erc20' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AND topic3 IS NULL AND address IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.to AS account, 'credit' AS side, t.value AS amount, 'erc20' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AND topic3 IS NULL AND address IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.dst AS account, 'credit' AS side, t.wad AS amount, 'wrap' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Deposit(address indexed dst, uint256 wad)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Deposit(address indexed dst, uint256 wad)') AND address = X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.src AS account, 'debit' AS side, t.wad AS amount, 'unwrap' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Withdrawal(address indexed src, uint256 wad)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Withdrawal(address indexed src, uint256 wad)') AND address = X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, arrow_cast(0, 'UInt32') AS log_index, arrow_cast(X'0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', 'FixedSizeBinary(20)') AS token, "from" AS account, 'debit' AS side, value AS amount, 'eth' AS kind FROM base.transactions WHERE status AND value <> '0'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, arrow_cast(0, 'UInt32') AS log_index, arrow_cast(X'0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', 'FixedSizeBinary(20)') AS token, "to" AS account, 'credit' AS side, value AS amount, 'eth' AS kind FROM base.transactions WHERE status AND value <> '0' AND "to" IS NOT NULL
) WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM (
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.from AS account, 'debit' AS side, t.value AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AND topic3 IS NULL AND address NOT IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.to AS account, 'credit' AS side, t.value AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)') AND topic3 IS NULL AND address NOT IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.from AS account, 'debit' AS side, t.id AS amount, 'unlisted_nft' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed id)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed id)') AND topic3 IS NOT NULL AND address NOT IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.to AS account, 'credit' AS side, t.id AS amount, 'unlisted_nft' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed id)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed id)') AND topic3 IS NOT NULL AND address NOT IN (X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006', X'833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913', X'fde4c96c8593536e31f229ea8f37b2ada2699bb2', X'50c5725949a6f0c72e6c4a641f24049a917db0cb', X'2ae3f1ec7f1f5012cfeab0185bfc7aa3cf0dec22', X'c1cba3fcea344f92d9239c08c0568f6f2f0ee452', X'cbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf', X'940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631', X'0b3e328455c4059eeb9e3f84b5543f74e24e7e1b', X'4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.from AS account, 'debit' AS side, '' AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value)') AND TRUE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.to AS account, 'credit' AS side, '' AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value)') AND TRUE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.from AS account, 'debit' AS side, '' AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values)') AND TRUE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, t.to AS account, 'credit' AS side, '' AS amount, 'unlisted' AS kind FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, address AS token, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values)') AS t
    FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values)') AND TRUE)
) WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT a.block_num, a.timestamp, a.tx_hash, a.tx_index, a."from" AS account,
  CAST(a.gas_used AS VARCHAR) AS cumulative, CAST(p.gas_used AS VARCHAR) AS previous,
  CAST(a.gas_price AS VARCHAR) AS gas_price, CAST(a.max_fee_per_gas AS VARCHAR) AS max_fee, CAST(a.max_priority_fee_per_gas AS VARCHAR) AS max_priority
FROM base.transactions a
JOIN base.transactions p ON a._block_num = p._block_num AND a.tx_index = p.tx_index + 1
WHERE a.type <> 126 AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT g.block_num, g.timestamp, g.tx_hash, g.tx_index, arrow_cast(0, 'UInt32') AS log_index, arrow_cast(X'0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', 'FixedSizeBinary(20)') AS token, g.account AS account, 'debit' AS side,
  self.pt_gas(g.cumulative, g.previous, g.gas_price, g.max_fee, g.max_priority, CAST(b.base_fee_per_gas AS VARCHAR)) AS amount, 'gas' AS kind
FROM self.tx_gas g
JOIN base.blocks b ON g._block_num = b._block_num
WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT l.block_num, l.timestamp, l.tx_hash, l.tx_index, l.log_index, arrow_cast(X'0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', 'FixedSizeBinary(20)') AS token, x."from" AS account, 'credit' AS side,
  get_field(evm_decode_log(l.topic1, l.topic2, l.topic3, l.data, 'Withdrawal(address indexed src, uint256 wad)'), 'wad') AS amount, 'unwrap' AS kind
FROM base.logs l
JOIN base.transactions x ON l._block_num = x._block_num AND l.tx_hash = x.tx_hash
WHERE l.address = X'4200000000000000000000000000000000000006' AND l.topic0 = evm_topic('Withdrawal(address indexed src, uint256 wad)') AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM (
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM self.base_legs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM self.gas_legs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, tx_index, log_index, token, account, side, amount, kind FROM self.unwrap_legs
) WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, CASE WHEN address IN (X'05c84a58FE042275b37db038bAAcD15F410c7bB0') THEN 'eth' ELSE 'usdc' END AS feed,
  CASE WHEN address IN (X'05c84a58FE042275b37db038bAAcD15F410c7bB0') THEN timestamp + INTERVAL '2600 seconds' ELSE timestamp + INTERVAL '90000 seconds' END AS valid_until,
  get_field(t, 'current') AS answer, get_field(t, 'roundId') AS round_id, get_field(t, 'updatedAt') AS updated_at
FROM (SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, evm_decode_log(topic1, topic2, topic3, data, 'AnswerUpdated(int256 indexed current, uint256 indexed roundId, uint256 updatedAt)') AS t
  FROM base.logs WHERE topic0 = evm_topic('AnswerUpdated(int256 indexed current, uint256 indexed roundId, uint256 updatedAt)') AND address IN (X'05c84a58FE042275b37db038bAAcD15F410c7bB0', X'68bE4C50235205Ede361ac8244B1ee221CDDA5E2'))
WHERE block_num() >= 53469029

SELECT b.block_num AS at_block, b.timestamp, u.feed, u.block_num AS update_block, u.log_index, u.tx_hash, u.answer
FROM base.blocks b
JOIN self.price_updates u ON b.block_num >= u.block_num AND b.timestamp < u.valid_until
WHERE b._block_num >= 53514029 AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, timestamp, eth_answer, usdc_answer, eth_tx, usdc_tx FROM (
  SELECT at_block AS block_num, timestamp,
    last_value(answer ORDER BY update_block, log_index) FILTER (WHERE feed = 'eth') AS eth_answer,
    last_value(answer ORDER BY update_block, log_index) FILTER (WHERE feed = 'usdc') AS usdc_answer,
    last_value(tx_hash ORDER BY update_block, log_index) FILTER (WHERE feed = 'eth') AS eth_tx,
    last_value(tx_hash ORDER BY update_block, log_index) FILTER (WHERE feed = 'usdc') AS usdc_tx
  FROM self.carried GROUP BY block_num(), at_block, timestamp
) WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, account, token, get_field(net, 'side') AS side, get_field(net, 'amount') AS amount FROM (
  SELECT block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, account, token, self.pt_net(string_agg(CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE concat('-', amount) END, ',')) AS net
  FROM self.legs WHERE kind <> 'gas'
  GROUP BY block_num(), block_num, timestamp, tx_hash, account, token
) WHERE get_field(net, 'side') <> '' AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT a.block_num, a.timestamp, a.tx_hash, a.account,
  a.token AS sold_token, a.amount AS sold_amount,
  b.token AS bought_token, b.amount AS bought_amount
FROM self.net_legs a
JOIN self.net_legs b ON a._block_num = b._block_num AND a.tx_hash = b.tx_hash AND a.account = b.account
WHERE a.side = 'debit' AND b.side = 'credit' AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT block_num, tx_hash, account, token FROM (
  SELECT block_num, tx_hash, account, token,
    self.pt_net(string_agg(CASE WHEN kind = 'unlisted_nft' THEN CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN '1' ELSE '-1' END WHEN side = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE concat('-', amount) END, ',')) AS net,
    bool_or(COALESCE(amount, '') = '') AS unreadable
  FROM self.unlisted_legs
  GROUP BY block_num(), block_num, tx_hash, account, token, CASE WHEN kind = 'unlisted_nft' THEN amount ELSE '' END
) WHERE (get_field(net, 'side') <> '' OR unreadable) AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT bn, tx_hash, account, pair_count FROM (
  SELECT block_num() AS bn, tx_hash, account, COUNT(*) AS pair_count FROM (
    SELECT block_num, tx_hash, account FROM self.pairs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT block_num, tx_hash, account FROM self.unlisted_moves
  ) GROUP BY block_num(), tx_hash, account
) WHERE block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT p.block_num, p.timestamp, p.tx_hash, p.account, p.sold_token, p.sold_amount, p.bought_token, p.bought_amount
FROM self.pairs p
JOIN self.pair_counts c ON p._block_num = c._block_num AND p.tx_hash = c.tx_hash AND p.account = c.account
WHERE c.pair_count = 1 AND block_num() >= 53514029

SELECT p.block_num, p.timestamp, p.tx_hash, p.account,
  p.sold_token, p.sold_amount, p.bought_token, p.bought_amount,
  r.eth_answer AS eth_usd, r.usdc_answer AS usdc_usd, r.eth_tx, r.usdc_tx,
  self.pt_price(evm_decode_hex(p.sold_token), p.sold_amount, evm_decode_hex(p.bought_token), p.bought_amount, r.eth_answer, r.usdc_answer) AS priced
FROM self.single_pairs p
JOIN self.reference_prices r ON p._block_num = r._block_num
WHERE block_num() >= 53514029
